---
title: "Space-time structures for imputing sparse soil records with R-INLA"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---

# What this document does

The current imputation model is one separable field, `Besag x AR1` (Kronecker product), with no main effects
and no extra interaction term. This document fits a family of 25 space-time structures around it
(space only, time only, additive, the four Knorr-Held interaction types, Kronecker variants, field-specific dynamics),
on several soil responses, **in parallel on all the cores of the computer**, and ranks them with

* in-sample criteria : DIC, WAIC, mean log-CPO, marginal likelihood;
* out-of-sample skill on measurements the model never saw : RMSE, MAE, R2, 95 % coverage, CRPS, log score, for two schemes
  * `row`   : 10 % of the measured field-years held out at random (the real gap-filling situation);
  * `field` : 10 % of the fields held out entirely (prediction for a field never sampled).

Everything is written to `outputs/model_comparison/`. The run is **resumable** : each finished fit is saved,
so the document can be stopped and rendered again without losing work.

# 1. Settings

```{r settings}
GPKG   <- "../data/parcels_with_soil_complete.gpkg"     # path relative to this .qmd
OUTDIR <- "../outputs/model_comparison"                # created if missing

# responses : ALL numeric soil columns of the dataset are modelled (section 2 builds them automatically).
#   - strictly positive and right-skewed (skewness > SKEW_LOG) -> modelled on the log scale
#   - texture : modelled as ILR coordinates (3 parts sand/silt/clay AND 5 parts), never as raw percentages
#   - Texture (text class) and Detailed_Plot are not soil measurements and are skipped
VARS        <- "all"        # or a subset of the names printed in section 2, e.g. c("pH", "log_EC", "ILR3_1")
SKEW_LOG    <- 1            # skewness above which a strictly positive variable is log-transformed
RAW_TEXTURE <- FALSE        # TRUE also models the 7 texture percentages one by one (ignores closure to 100 %)
MIN_OBS     <- 200          # responses with fewer measurements are skipped
# fixed-effect sets crossed with the structures. The first one is the reference used in the figures.
FIXED  <- c("Bloc + irrg_ty", "1")
FIXED_1_MODELS <- c("S02", "S03", "S08", "S10", "S11", "S14", "S19", "S23")   # structures also run with intercept only
MODELS <- "all"            # or a regular expression, e.g. "S02|S08|S14"
SCHEMES <- c("row", "field")
N_REP  <- 3                # repeats of each hold-out scheme (different random hold-out sets)
HOLD   <- 0.10             # hold-out fraction
SEED   <- 123
DIST   <- 110              # neighbours = fields whose boundaries are closer than DIST metres
INT_STRATEGY <- "eb"       # "eb" = fast screening ; "ccd" = full integration over the hyperparameters

# parallel set-up : N_WORKERS fits run at the same time, each INLA fit uses THREADS_PER_FIT threads.
# Keep N_WORKERS * THREADS_PER_FIT <= number of cores. The Kronecker models need about 3-4 GB of RAM each.
N_CORES         <- parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE)
THREADS_PER_FIT <- 2
N_WORKERS       <- max(1, floor((N_CORES - 1) / THREADS_PER_FIT))
TIME_LIMIT      <- 3 * 3600    # seconds allowed for one INLA fit (0 = no limit)
RUN_HEAVY       <- TRUE        # FALSE: the slow Kronecker / type III-IV structures only run on HEAVY_VARS
HEAVY_VARS      <- c("pH", "OC", "log_P2O5", "Ca", "ILR3_1", "ILR3_2")

dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "fits"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("cores:", N_CORES, " workers:", N_WORKERS, " threads per fit:", THREADS_PER_FIT, "\n")
```

```{r packages}
pk <- c("sf", "Matrix", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "parallel")
for (p in setdiff(pk, rownames(installed.packages()))) install.packages(p)
if (!"INLA" %in% rownames(installed.packages()))
  install.packages("INLA", repos = c(getOption("repos"), INLA = "https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"), dep = TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(sf); library(Matrix); library(INLA); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(parallel) })
```

# 2. Data, derived responses and neighbourhood graph

```{r data}
g   <- st_read(GPKG, quiet = TRUE)
fld <- g[!duplicated(g$ID.Field), "ID.Field"]; fld <- fld[order(fld$ID.Field), ]
stopifnot(all(fld$ID.Field == seq_len(nrow(fld))))            # ID.Field must be 1..n

nb <- st_is_within_distance(fld, fld, dist = DIST)
W  <- sparseMatrix(i = rep(seq_along(nb), lengths(nb)), j = unlist(nb), x = 1, dims = rep(nrow(fld), 2))
diag(W) <- 0; W <- drop0(W)
cat("fields:", nrow(W), "| mean number of neighbours:", round(mean(rowSums(W)), 2), "| isolated fields:", sum(rowSums(W) == 0), "\n")

d <- st_drop_geometry(g); d <- d[order(d$ID.Field, d$Year), ]
d$ID.Year <- as.integer(d$Year - min(d$Year) + 1)
d$Bloc <- factor(d$Bloc); d$irrg_ty <- factor(d$irrg_ty)

# ---- build every response automatically ----
SOIL <- c("pH", "CN_Ratio", "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm", "Exchangeable_Calcium_meq_100g", "Exchangeable_Magnesium_meq_100g",
          "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g", "Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g", "Available_P2O5_mg_kg", "Organic_Carbon_per_mille",
          "Total_Nitrogen_per_mille", "Organic_Matter_percent", "Sum_of_Exchangeable_Bases_meq_100g", "CaO_g_100g", "Mg_Ca_Ratio",
          "Mg_K_Ratio", "Compaction_Index")
TEXT <- c("Clay_percent", "Fine_Silt_percent", "Coarse_Silt_percent", "Fine_Sand_percent", "Coarse_Sand_percent", "Total_Silt_percent", "Total_Sand_percent")
SOIL <- intersect(SOIL, names(d))
# any other numeric column that is not an identifier / coordinate / texture is also taken
OTHER <- setdiff(names(d)[sapply(d, is.numeric)], c(SOIL, TEXT, "ID.Field", "ID.Year", "Year", "Month", "X.Centroid", "Y.Centroid", "area_ha", "Detailed_Plot"))
SOIL <- c(SOIL, OTHER)
SHORT <- c(pH = "pH", CN_Ratio = "CN", Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm = "EC", Exchangeable_Calcium_meq_100g = "Ca",
           Exchangeable_Magnesium_meq_100g = "Mg", Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g = "Na", Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g = "K",
           Available_P2O5_mg_kg = "P2O5", Organic_Carbon_per_mille = "OC", Total_Nitrogen_per_mille = "N", Organic_Matter_percent = "OM",
           Sum_of_Exchangeable_Bases_meq_100g = "SumBases", CaO_g_100g = "CaO", Mg_Ca_Ratio = "Mg_Ca", Mg_K_Ratio = "Mg_K", Compaction_Index = "Compaction")
GROUP <- c(pH = "Acidity & salinity", EC = "Acidity & salinity", Na = "Acidity & salinity", Ca = "Exchangeable cations", Mg = "Exchangeable cations",
           K = "Exchangeable cations", SumBases = "Exchangeable cations", CaO = "Exchangeable cations", Mg_Ca = "Exchangeable cations", Mg_K = "Exchangeable cations",
           OC = "Organic matter & nutrients", N = "Organic matter & nutrients", OM = "Organic matter & nutrients", CN = "Organic matter & nutrients",
           P2O5 = "Organic matter & nutrients", Compaction = "Physical")
skew <- function(x) { x <- x[is.finite(x)]; mean((x - mean(x))^3) / sd(x)^3 }
VINFO <- NULL
for (col in SOIL) {
  x <- d[[col]]; if (sum(!is.na(x)) < MIN_OBS) next
  sh <- if (!is.na(SHORT[col])) unname(SHORT[col]) else col
  uselog <- all(x[!is.na(x)] > 0) && skew(x) > SKEW_LOG
  nm <- if (uselog) paste0("log_", sh) else sh
  d[[nm]] <- if (uselog) log(x) else x
  VINFO <- rbind(VINFO, data.frame(Variable = nm, source = col, transform = ifelse(uselog, "log", "none"),
                                   group = ifelse(is.na(GROUP[sh]), "Other", GROUP[sh]), n_obs = sum(!is.na(x)), skewness = round(skew(x), 2)))
}

# ---- texture : isometric log-ratio (pivot) coordinates ----
# pivot coordinate k of a D-part composition: sqrt((D-k)/(D-k+1)) * log( x_k / geometric mean(x_{k+1..D}) )
ilr_pivot <- function(X) {
  X <- pmax(as.matrix(X), 0.1); X <- X / rowSums(X); D <- ncol(X)
  sapply(1:(D - 1), function(k) sqrt((D - k) / (D - k + 1)) * (log(X[, k]) - rowMeans(log(X[, (k + 1):D, drop = FALSE]))))
}
add_ilr <- function(parts, prefix, meaning) {
  ok <- complete.cases(d[parts]); Z <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(d), length(parts) - 1); Z[ok, ] <- ilr_pivot(d[ok, parts])
  for (k in seq_len(ncol(Z))) {
    nm <- paste0(prefix, "_", k); d[[nm]] <<- Z[, k]
    VINFO <<- rbind(VINFO, data.frame(Variable = nm, source = paste(parts, collapse = " / "), transform = paste0("ILR: ", meaning[k]),
                                      group = "Texture (ILR)", n_obs = sum(ok), skewness = round(skew(Z[, k]), 2)))
  }
}
if (all(c("Total_Sand_percent", "Total_Silt_percent", "Clay_percent") %in% names(d)))      # 3 parts
  add_ilr(c("Total_Sand_percent", "Total_Silt_percent", "Clay_percent"), "ILR3", c("sand | silt·clay", "silt | clay"))
P5 <- c("Coarse_Sand_percent", "Fine_Sand_percent", "Coarse_Silt_percent", "Fine_Silt_percent", "Clay_percent")
if (all(P5 %in% names(d)))                                                                    # 5 parts
  add_ilr(P5, "ILR5", c("coarse sand | rest", "fine sand | silts·clay", "coarse silt | fine silt·clay", "fine silt | clay"))
if (RAW_TEXTURE) for (col in intersect(TEXT, names(d))) {
  nm <- sub("_percent", "", col); d[[nm]] <- d[[col]]
  VINFO <- rbind(VINFO, data.frame(Variable = nm, source = col, transform = "none (raw %)", group = "Texture (raw %)", n_obs = sum(!is.na(d[[col]])), skewness = round(skew(d[[col]]), 2)))
}
if (identical(VARS, "all")) VARS <- VINFO$Variable
VARS <- intersect(VARS, VINFO$Variable)
for (v in VARS) d[[v]][!is.finite(d[[v]])] <- NA
write.csv(VINFO, file.path(OUTDIR, "responses_modelled.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(VINFO, row.names = FALSE)

# copies of the indices (INLA needs a distinct index name for each f() term)
d$ID.Field2 <- d$ID.Field; d$ID.Field3 <- d$ID.Field; d$ID.Obs <- seq_len(nrow(d)); d$YearC <- as.numeric(scale(d$ID.Year))
cat(length(VARS), "responses will be modelled\n")
```

# 3. Priors and candidate structures

The response is standardised before each fit, so the same penalised-complexity priors are used for every variable.

```{r models}
pcp   <- function(u = 1, a = 0.01) list(prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(u, a)))
rho_  <- list(rho = list(prior = "pc.cor1", param = c(0.9, 0.9)))
bym2h <- list(prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(1, 0.01)), phi = list(prior = "pc", param = c(0.5, 0.5)))

bes  <- 'f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W, scale.model = TRUE, constr = TRUE, hyper = pcp())'
bym  <- 'f(ID.Field, model = "bym2", graph = W, scale.model = TRUE, constr = TRUE, hyper = bym2h)'
ar1t <- 'f(ID.Year, model = "ar1", hyper = c(pcp(), rho_))'
iidf <- function(idx) paste0('f(', idx, ', model = "iid", hyper = pcp())')
kron <- function(idx, gm) paste0('f(', idx, ', model = "besag", graph = W, scale.model = TRUE, constr = TRUE, group = ID.Year, ',
                                 'control.group = list(model = "', gm, '"', if (gm == "ar1") ", hyper = rho_" else "", '), hyper = pcp())')
pl <- function(...) paste(..., sep = " + ")

STRUCT <- list(
  S00_none                 = "",
  S01_iidField             = iidf("ID.Field"),
  S02_besag                = bes,
  S03_bym2                 = bym,
  S04_ar1Time              = ar1t,
  S05_rw1Time              = 'f(ID.Year, model = "rw1", scale.model = TRUE, constr = TRUE, hyper = pcp())',
  S06_rw2Time              = 'f(ID.Year, model = "rw2", scale.model = TRUE, constr = TRUE, hyper = pcp())',
  S07_iidField_ar1Time     = pl(iidf("ID.Field"), ar1t),
  S08_besag_ar1Time        = pl(bes, ar1t),                                   # additive space + time
  S09_bym2_ar1Time         = pl(bym, ar1t),
  S10_KH1_iidObs           = pl(bes, ar1t, iidf("ID.Obs")),                   # Knorr-Held type I
  S11_KH2_iidSp_x_ar1      = pl(bes, ar1t, 'f(ID.Field2, model = "iid", group = ID.Year, control.group = list(model = "ar1", hyper = rho_), hyper = pcp())'),   # type II
  S12_KH3_besag_per_year   = pl(bes, ar1t, 'f(ID.Field2, model = "besag", graph = W, scale.model = TRUE, constr = TRUE, replicate = ID.Year, hyper = pcp())'),  # type III
  S13_KH4_besag_x_ar1      = pl(bes, ar1t, kron("ID.Field2", "ar1")),         # type IV
  S14_CURRENT_besag_x_ar1  = kron("ID.Field", "ar1"),                         # the model used so far
  S15_besag_x_rw1          = kron("ID.Field", "rw1"),
  S16_besag_x_exch         = kron("ID.Field", "exchangeable"),
  S17_iidField_besag_x_ar1 = pl(iidf("ID.Field2"), kron("ID.Field", "ar1")),
  S18_ar1PerField          = 'f(ID.Year, model = "ar1", replicate = ID.Field, hyper = c(pcp(), rho_))',
  S19_iid_ar1PerField      = pl(iidf("ID.Field2"), 'f(ID.Year, model = "ar1", replicate = ID.Field, hyper = c(pcp(), rho_))'),
  S20_besag_ar1PerField    = pl(bes, 'f(ID.Year, model = "ar1", replicate = ID.Field3, hyper = c(pcp(), rho_))'),
  S21_besag_slope          = pl(bes, 'f(ID.Field2, YearC, model = "iid", hyper = pcp())'),
  S22_besag_ar1_slope      = pl(bes, ar1t, 'f(ID.Field2, YearC, model = "iid", hyper = pcp())'),
  S23_bym2_ar1_iidObs      = pl(bym, ar1t, iidf("ID.Obs")),
  S24_bym2_besag_x_ar1     = pl('f(ID.Field2, model = "bym2", graph = W, scale.model = TRUE, constr = TRUE, hyper = bym2h)', kron("ID.Field", "ar1"))
)
if (MODELS != "all") STRUCT <- STRUCT[grepl(MODELS, names(STRUCT))]
HEAVY <- c("S12", "S13", "S14", "S15", "S16", "S17", "S24")    # slow structures (Besag replicated or grouped over the years)
```

# 4. Fitting functions

```{r functions}
make_mask <- function(y, field, scheme, seed) {              # TRUE = held out
  set.seed(seed); obs <- which(!is.na(y)); m <- rep(FALSE, length(y))
  if (scheme == "row") m[sample(obs, ceiling(HOLD * length(obs)))] <- TRUE
  else { f <- unique(field[obs]); h <- sample(f, ceiling(HOLD * length(f))); m[field %in% h & !is.na(y)] <- TRUE }
  m
}

fit_one <- function(v, st, fs, held, theta = NULL) {
  dd <- d; dd$y_raw <- dd[[v]]
  dd$Y <- ifelse(held, NA, dd$y_raw); mu <- mean(dd$Y, na.rm = TRUE); sdv <- sd(dd$Y, na.rm = TRUE); dd$Y <- (dd$Y - mu) / sdv
  rhs <- paste(c(fs, if (nzchar(STRUCT[[st]])) STRUCT[[st]]), collapse = " + ")
  t0  <- Sys.time()
  fit <- tryCatch(
    inla(as.formula(paste("Y ~", rhs)), data = dd, family = "gaussian", control.family = list(hyper = pcp()),
         control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
         control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
         # Gaussian likelihood: the Gaussian approximation is exact, so "gaussian" loses nothing and is the fastest strategy
         control.inla = list(strategy = "gaussian", int.strategy = INT_STRATEGY),
         control.mode = if (is.null(theta)) list() else list(theta = theta, restart = TRUE),
         num.threads = THREADS_PER_FIT, verbose = FALSE),
    error = function(e) { message("   ! ", v, " | ", st, " : ", substr(conditionMessage(e), 1, 200)); NULL })
  if (is.null(fit) || is.null(fit$summary.fitted.values)) return(NULL)
  list(fit = fit, d = dd, mu = mu, sdv = sdv, minutes = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins")))
}

# one task = one variable x fixed set x structure : full-data fit + hold-out fits; the result is saved as an .rds file
run_task <- function(k) {
  v <- TASKS$Variable[k]; fs <- TASKS$Fixed[k]; st <- TASKS$Model[k]
  file <- file.path(OUTDIR, "fits", paste0(v, "__", ifelse(fs == "1", "F0", "F1"), "__", st, ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(file)) return("done before")
  if (TIME_LIMIT > 0) try(inla.setOption(inla.timeout = TIME_LIMIT), silent = TRUE)
  full <- fit_one(v, st, fs, rep(FALSE, nrow(d)))
  if (is.null(full)) { saveRDS(list(res = data.frame(Variable = v, Fixed = fs, Model = st, failed = TRUE)), file); return("failed") }
  f <- full$fit; cpo <- f$cpo$cpo; okc <- !is.na(cpo) & cpo > 0 & (is.na(f$cpo$failure) | f$cpo$failure < 1)
  res <- data.frame(Variable = v, Fixed = fs, Model = st, failed = FALSE, n_obs = sum(!is.na(full$d$Y)), minutes = full$minutes,
                    DIC = f$dic$dic, pD = f$dic$p.eff, WAIC = f$waic$waic, pW = f$waic$p.eff,
                    LCPO = -mean(log(cpo[okc])), cpo_fail = sum(!okc & !is.na(full$d$Y)), MLIK = f$mlik[1, 1])
  h <- f$summary.hyperpar
  hyp <- data.frame(Variable = v, Fixed = fs, Model = st, par = rownames(h), mean = h$mean, sd = h$sd, q025 = h$`0.025quant`, q975 = h$`0.975quant`)
  pred <- NULL
  for (sc in SCHEMES) {
    S <- NULL
    for (rp in seq_len(N_REP)) {
      held <- make_mask(full$d$y_raw, d$ID.Field, sc, SEED + rp)
      r <- fit_one(v, st, fs, held, theta = f$mode$theta); if (is.null(r)) next
      i <- which(held); s <- r$fit$summary.fitted.values; hh <- r$fit$summary.hyperpar
      s2e <- 1 / hh[grep("Gaussian observations", rownames(hh)), "mean"]                     # observation-noise variance
      p <- s$mean[i]; ps <- sqrt(s$sd[i]^2 + s2e); lo <- p - 1.96 * ps; hi <- p + 1.96 * ps    # predictive distribution of a new measurement
      y <- (r$d$y_raw[i] - r$mu) / r$sdv; z <- (y - p) / ps                                   # standardised scale
      S <- rbind(S, data.frame(RMSE = sqrt(mean((p - y)^2)), MAE = mean(abs(p - y)), R2 = 1 - sum((p - y)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2),
                               COV95 = mean(y >= lo & y <= hi), WIDTH = mean(hi - lo),
                               CRPS = mean(ps * (z * (2 * pnorm(z) - 1) + 2 * dnorm(z) - 1 / sqrt(pi))),
                               LOGS = -mean(dnorm(y, p, ps, log = TRUE)), minutes = r$minutes))
      pred <- rbind(pred, data.frame(Variable = v, Fixed = fs, Model = st, scheme = sc, rep = rp, field = d$ID.Field[i], year = d$Year[i],
                                     y = y, pred = p, lo = lo, hi = hi, y_raw = r$d$y_raw[i], mu = r$mu, sd = r$sdv))
    }
    m <- if (is.null(S)) setNames(rep(NA_real_, 8), c("RMSE", "MAE", "R2", "COV95", "WIDTH", "CRPS", "LOGS", "minutes")) else colMeans(S)
    names(m) <- paste0(names(m), "_", sc); res <- cbind(res, as.data.frame(t(m)))
    res[[paste0("R2_sd_", sc)]] <- if (is.null(S) || nrow(S) < 2) NA_real_ else sd(S$R2)
  }
  saveRDS(list(res = res, hyper = hyp, pred = pred), file)
  "ok"
}
```

# 5. Run everything in parallel

```{r run}
#| eval: true
TASKS <- expand.grid(Model = names(STRUCT), Fixed = FIXED, Variable = VARS, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
TASKS <- TASKS[TASKS$Fixed != "1" | substr(TASKS$Model, 1, 3) %in% FIXED_1_MODELS, ]
TASKS$heavy <- substr(TASKS$Model, 1, 3) %in% HEAVY
if (!RUN_HEAVY) TASKS <- TASKS[!TASKS$heavy | TASKS$Variable %in% HEAVY_VARS, ]
TASKS <- TASKS[order(-TASKS$heavy), ]; rownames(TASKS) <- NULL       # slow structures are dispatched first
cat(nrow(TASKS), "tasks (", length(VARS), "responses ) ;", sum(TASKS$heavy), "slow ones\n")
# rough duration: light structure ~ 1 min per fit, slow structure ~ 10 min per fit with 2 threads; each task = 1 + length(SCHEMES) * N_REP fits
est_h <- (sum(!TASKS$heavy) * 1 + sum(TASKS$heavy) * 10) * (1 + length(SCHEMES) * N_REP) / 60 / N_WORKERS
cat("rough duration :", round(est_h, 1), "hours with", N_WORKERS, "workers.",
    "Set RUN_HEAVY <- FALSE (or fewer N_REP) for a faster first pass.\n")

t0 <- Sys.time()
cl <- makeCluster(N_WORKERS, outfile = file.path(OUTDIR, "workers_log.txt"))
clusterEvalQ(cl, { suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(INLA); library(Matrix) }) })
clusterExport(cl, c("d", "W", "STRUCT", "TASKS", "OUTDIR", "SCHEMES", "N_REP", "HOLD", "SEED", "INT_STRATEGY", "THREADS_PER_FIT", "TIME_LIMIT",
                    "pcp", "rho_", "bym2h", "make_mask", "fit_one", "run_task"))
status <- parLapplyLB(cl, seq_len(nrow(TASKS)), function(k) tryCatch(run_task(k), error = function(e) paste("error:", conditionMessage(e))), chunk.size = 1)
stopCluster(cl)
print(table(unlist(status)))
cat("elapsed:", round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "hours")), 2), "hours\n")
```

# 6. Collect the results and rank the structures

```{r collect}
ff  <- list.files(file.path(OUTDIR, "fits"), pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
ALL <- lapply(ff, readRDS)
R   <- bind_rows(lapply(ALL, `[[`, "res")); if (!"failed" %in% names(R)) R$failed <- FALSE
FAILED <- R %>% filter(failed) %>% select(Variable, Fixed, Model); R <- R %>% filter(!failed)
for (cc in c(outer(c("RMSE", "MAE", "R2", "COV95", "WIDTH", "CRPS", "LOGS", "minutes", "R2_sd"), c("row", "field"), paste, sep = "_")))
  if (!cc %in% names(R)) R[[cc]] <- NA_real_                  # schemes not run -> empty columns
P   <- bind_rows(lapply(ALL, `[[`, "pred")); H <- bind_rows(lapply(ALL, `[[`, "hyper"))
write.csv(R, file.path(OUTDIR, "all_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(H, file.path(OUTDIR, "hyperparameters.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(P, file.path(OUTDIR, "holdout_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(FAILED, file.path(OUTDIR, "failed_fits.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

CUR <- "S14_CURRENT_besag_x_ar1"; F1 <- FIXED[1]
LAB <- c(S00_none = "Fixed effects only", S01_iidField = "Field iid", S02_besag = "Besag", S03_bym2 = "BYM2", S04_ar1Time = "AR1 (years)",
         S05_rw1Time = "RW1 (years)", S06_rw2Time = "RW2 (years)", S07_iidField_ar1Time = "Field iid + AR1", S08_besag_ar1Time = "Besag + AR1",
         S09_bym2_ar1Time = "BYM2 + AR1", S10_KH1_iidObs = "Besag + AR1 + iid field-year (type I)", S11_KH2_iidSp_x_ar1 = "Besag + AR1 + iid x AR1 (type II)",
         S12_KH3_besag_per_year = "Besag + AR1 + Besag per year (type III)", S13_KH4_besag_x_ar1 = "Besag + AR1 + Besag x AR1 (type IV)",
         S14_CURRENT_besag_x_ar1 = "Besag x AR1 (current)", S15_besag_x_rw1 = "Besag x RW1", S16_besag_x_exch = "Besag x exchangeable",
         S17_iidField_besag_x_ar1 = "Field iid + Besag x AR1", S18_ar1PerField = "AR1 per field", S19_iid_ar1PerField = "Field iid + AR1 per field",
         S20_besag_ar1PerField = "Besag + AR1 per field", S21_besag_slope = "Besag + field slope", S22_besag_ar1_slope = "Besag + AR1 + field slope",
         S23_bym2_ar1_iidObs = "BYM2 + AR1 + iid field-year", S24_bym2_besag_x_ar1 = "BYM2 + Besag x AR1")
FAMILY <- c(S00 = "no random effect", S01 = "space only", S02 = "space only", S03 = "space only", S04 = "time only", S05 = "time only", S06 = "time only",
            S07 = "space + time", S08 = "space + time", S09 = "space + time", S10 = "space + time + interaction", S11 = "space + time + interaction",
            S12 = "space + time + interaction", S13 = "space + time + interaction", S14 = "Kronecker space x time", S15 = "Kronecker space x time",
            S16 = "Kronecker space x time", S17 = "Kronecker space x time", S18 = "field-specific dynamics", S19 = "field-specific dynamics",
            S20 = "field-specific dynamics", S21 = "field-specific dynamics", S22 = "field-specific dynamics", S23 = "space + time + interaction", S24 = "Kronecker space x time")
FAMCOL <- c("no random effect" = "#9AA3AF", "space only" = "#A0663A", "time only" = "#3B8BC2", "space + time" = "#3E8E5A",
            "space + time + interaction" = "#7A5BA6", "Kronecker space x time" = "#C8553D", "field-specific dynamics" = "#2A9D8F")
R$label <- LAB[R$Model]; R$family <- FAMILY[substr(R$Model, 1, 3)]
R <- R %>% left_join(VINFO %>% select(Variable, group), by = "Variable")
VORD <- VINFO$Variable[VINFO$Variable %in% R$Variable]                # columns ordered by group
GORD <- unique(VINFO$group[VINFO$Variable %in% R$Variable])
R$Variable <- factor(R$Variable, levels = VORD); R$group <- factor(R$group, levels = GORD)
RM <- R %>% filter(Fixed == F1)

RANK <- RM %>% group_by(Variable) %>%
  mutate(dWAIC = WAIC - min(WAIC, na.rm = TRUE), rk_row = rank(-R2_row), rk_field = rank(-R2_field), rk_WAIC = rank(WAIC),
         gain_vs_current = R2_row - ifelse(any(Model == CUR), R2_row[Model == CUR][1], NA_real_)) %>%
  group_by(Model, label, family) %>%
  summarise(n_var = n(), R2_row = mean(R2_row, na.rm = TRUE), R2_field = mean(R2_field, na.rm = TRUE), gain_vs_current = mean(gain_vs_current, na.rm = TRUE),
            RMSE_row = mean(RMSE_row, na.rm = TRUE), CRPS_row = mean(CRPS_row, na.rm = TRUE), COV95_row = mean(COV95_row, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_rank_row = mean(rk_row), mean_rank_field = mean(rk_field), mean_rank_WAIC = mean(rk_WAIC), mean_dWAIC = mean(dWAIC),
            minutes_full_fit = mean(minutes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(gain_vs_current), desc(R2_row))
write.csv(RANK, file.path(OUTDIR, "ranking_overall.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
BEST <- RM %>% group_by(Variable) %>% slice_max(R2_row, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% select(Variable, Model, label, R2_row, R2_field, RMSE_row, COV95_row, WAIC)
write.csv(BEST, file.path(OUTDIR, "best_model_per_variable.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(RANK %>% select(label, n_var, R2_row, R2_field, gain_vs_current, COV95_row, mean_rank_WAIC, minutes_full_fit), digits = 3)
knitr::kable(BEST, digits = 3)
```

# 7. Figures

```{r theme}
INK <- "#1F2733"; GREY <- "#6B7482"
th <- theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(text = element_text(colour = INK), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20), plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = GREY, size = 12.5),
        plot.title.position = "plot", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#E3E7EC", linewidth = 0.4),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = GREY), axis.title = element_text(colour = GREY), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank(), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
sv <- function(p, name, w, h) { ggsave(file.path(OUTDIR, "figures", paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
                                ggsave(file.path(OUTDIR, "figures", paste0(name, ".pdf")), p, width = w, height = h, bg = "white"); p }
ord <- RANK$label                                   # best structure first
bold_cur <- function(l) ifelse(l == LAB[CUR], "bold", "plain")
```

## 7.1 Hold-out R2 of every structure, for every response

```{r fig1}
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 9
D1 <- RM %>% mutate(label = factor(label, levels = rev(ord))) %>% group_by(Variable) %>% mutate(best = R2_row >= max(R2_row, na.rm = TRUE) - 1e-9) %>% ungroup()
p1 <- ggplot(D1, aes(Variable, label, fill = R2_row)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", R2_row), fontface = ifelse(best, "bold", "plain"), colour = R2_row > quantile(R2_row, 0.6, na.rm = TRUE)), size = ifelse(length(VORD) > 14, 3.3, 4.2), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = INK)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#F4F6F9", "#CFE3F1", "#7FB5DA", "#2F6BA8", "#173A63"), name = "hold-out R2") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") + facet_grid(~group, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", switch = "x") +
  labs(title = "Which space-time structure imputes soil best?",
       subtitle = paste0("Hold-out R2 on ", 100 * HOLD, " % of the measured field-years (random, never seen by the model) | fixed effects: ", F1), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  th + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(colour = INK, size = 12.5, face = bold_cur(levels(droplevels(D1$label)))),
             axis.text.x.top = element_text(colour = INK, face = "bold", angle = 50, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 11.5),
             strip.text.x = element_text(colour = GREY, face = "bold", size = 11.5, hjust = 0.5), strip.placement = "outside",
             panel.spacing.x = unit(10, "pt"), legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text(colour = GREY, size = 11))
sv(p1, "INLA1_structures_holdout_R2", max(13, 5.5 + 0.62 * length(VORD)), 3 + 0.36 * length(ord))
```

```{r fig4}

D4 <- RM %>% group_by(Variable) %>% mutate(dWAIC = WAIC - min(WAIC, na.rm = TRUE), is_cur = Model == CUR, is_best = R2_row == max(R2_row, na.rm = TRUE), right = dWAIC > 0.5 * max(dWAIC, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% ungroup()
p4 <- ggplot(D4, aes(dWAIC, R2_row, colour = family)) + geom_point(size = 3.4, alpha = 0.9) +

  geom_text(data = filter(D4, is_best), aes(label = sub(" \\(type.*", "", label), hjust = ifelse(right, 1, 0)), colour = INK, fontface = "bold", size = 3.6, vjust = -1.1, show.legend = FALSE) +
```

## 7.5 Held-out measurements : observed against predicted, current and best structure

```{r fig5}
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 6
bm <- RM %>% filter(Model != CUR) %>% group_by(Variable) %>% slice_max(R2_row, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% transmute(Variable, Model, which = "best")
D5 <- P %>% filter(Fixed == F1, scheme == "row") %>% inner_join(bind_rows(bm, data.frame(Variable = unique(RM$Variable), Model = CUR, which = "current")), by = c("Variable", "Model")) %>%
  mutate(which = factor(which, levels = c("current", "best")))
L5 <- D5 %>% group_by(Variable, which, Model) %>% summarise(R2 = 1 - sum((pred - y)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(txt = paste0("R2 ", sprintf("%.2f", R2), ifelse(which == "best", paste0("\n", sub(" \\(type.*", "", LAB[Model])), "")))
for (pg in split(VORD, ceiling(seq_along(VORD) / 6))) {
p5 <- ggplot(filter(D5, Variable %in% pg), aes(y, pred, colour = which)) + geom_abline(colour = "#9AA3AF") + geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_text(data = filter(L5, Variable %in% pg), aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = txt), hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.25, colour = INK, fontface = "bold", size = 3.6, lineheight = 0.95, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(which ~ Variable, switch = "y") + scale_colour_manual(values = c(current = "#C8553D", best = "#2F6BA8"), guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-3.5, 3.5), ylim = c(-3.5, 3.5)) +
  labs(title = "Held-out measurements: observed against predicted", subtitle = "Standardised scale | random field-years held out, all repeats", x = "observed", y = "predicted") +
  th + theme(strip.placement = "outside", strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5), axis.text = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
             panel.border = element_rect(colour = "#B9C0CB", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5), strip.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12))
print(sv(p5, paste0("INLA5_observed_vs_predicted_", paste(pg[c(1, length(pg))], collapse = "-")), max(8, 1.95 * length(pg) + 1), 5.8))
}
```

# 8. Hyperparameters of the best structures

```{r hyper}
top <- head(RANK$Model, 3)
knitr::kable(H %>% filter(Fixed == F1, Model %in% c(top, CUR)) %>% mutate(label = LAB[Model]) %>% select(Variable, label, par, mean, q025, q975) %>% arrange(Variable, label), digits = 3)
```

# 9. How to read the outcome

* `ranking_overall.csv` : one line per structure, best first (gain in hold-out R2 over the current model).
* `best_model_per_variable.csv` : the structure with the highest hold-out R2 for each response.
* For imputation, trust the `row` scheme first : it reproduces the real missing-data pattern (unsampled years of sampled fields).
  WAIC and DIC often prefer structures with an iid field-year term that absorbs the noise without predicting better; figure 7.4 shows this.
* When two structures are within about 0.01 of R2, keep the simpler and faster one.
* To finish, set `INT_STRATEGY <- "ccd"` and `MODELS` to the two or three best structures, change `OUTDIR`, and render again for the final estimates.
